title: Saving a PIN from the one-time 'Set your own PIN' sheet is never tested
what: The only screen test of the sheet taps 'Not now' and sets the PIN later in Settings. No test saves from the sheet itself, sees 'Saving...' or the 3-second 'PIN saved' note, taps twice, or reloads before answering. No test signs a trainer in with a code at all, and no owner without a PIN is tested on screen.
expected: A screen test that saves a PIN from the sheet (once, with the note that goes away), and one that reloads before answering and still sees the sheet.
fix_line: Add a screen test that saves from the sheet and one that reloads before answering

title: The owner-only card's 'Back to Today' button and its reload are never tested
what: Tests check that Staff see 'Only an owner can see this' on owner pages, but none checks the 'Ask your gym owner' line, taps 'Back to Today', goes back, or reloads on the card.
expected: A test that taps 'Back to Today' and lands on Today, and that a reload or Back keeps the card without showing the owner page.
how_often: whenever staff open an old owner link
fix_line: Extend the front-desk test to tap Back to Today and reload on the card

title: Two desk safety messages are never tested: device out of space, and repeated save clashes
what: The message 'Nothing was saved: this device is out of space...' and 'Someone else is saving at the same time. Please try again.' are each written once in the code, and no test makes them appear or checks that nothing shows as saved.
expected: A test per case: a full device refuses the save with that message and shows nothing as saved; repeated clashes end with the clash message and no success note.
who: owners and staff at the desk
how_often: rare, on a full device or a busy desk
fix_line: Add two data tests that trigger the full device and the repeated clash

title: The refused-payment screens are tested only as data, never as what the desk sees
what: Data tests cover keeping a refused payment, saving it as cancelled and removing it. No screen test shows the three buttons, the 'Remove it from this device for good?' question, the Staff line that sign-out is allowed after a refusal, or that Staff get no remove or cancel buttons.
expected: A screen test with a refused payment: the line and buttons for an owner, the question before removal, and the Staff view without those buttons.
fix_line: Add a screen test for a refused payment as owner and as Staff

title: The 'Use a starter price list' button on Plans has no test
what: Only the length of the starter list (5) is checked. No test taps the button, checks the five names and prices, checks that a double tap adds five once, or sees the 'Some plans may already be added' message when it fails half-way.
expected: A test that taps the button once and twice and sees five plans, and one where a save fails half-way.
fix_line: Add a screen test for the starter price list button

title: The import money card is never tested after an undo, a second import, or when money cannot be worked out
what: Tests cover the money line for a fresh file. None imports the same file twice, undoes an import, changes the columns, or checks that the card leaves the money out (and never says Rs 0) when it cannot be worked out.
expected: Tests for the repeat, undo and no-money cases of the card.
fix_line: Add preview tests for repeat, undo and unknown money

title: The offline bar's 'Details shown are from' time and the Staff offline view are never checked
what: Screen tests check the offline bar's main words, but none checks the part that says how old the details are. The only offline screen tests run as the owner, so Staff opening offline (and seeing no money totals) is never seen.
expected: A screen test that reads the time in the bar and one that opens offline as Staff.
fix_line: Check the time in the bar and add a Staff offline run
